subject: 辽金北方·客栈（原创扩展；历史细部待考）
prompt: Create a NEW northern Liao-Jin version of the reference Song game map building, retaining its camera, complete very thin diamond footprint, true clean transparency, entrance direction and detailed realistic ancient architectural rendering. This is a CITY MAP SPRITE, not a perspective architectural showcase. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, 2:1 dimetric projection, ground axes +0.5 and -0.5, upright verticals, parallel lines, no perspective. Entrance screen LOWER LEFT. Both ground axes clearly readable; complete flat rectangular ground perimeter with LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT corners. Entire sprite occupies central 70 percent of canvas. Main light screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow lower right. Background alpha=0, NO glow, halo or gradient. No thick plinth, text, people, sky, landscape, neighboring structures, symbols, Ming/Qing palace ornaments or modern features. One self-contained building. Historic regional inspiration, original game interpretation rather than monument reconstruction. Subject: one Liao-Jin northern roadside town inn, rectangular footprint12m east-west by9m north-south. Connected two-story main lodging block and low side wing surrounding small open compacted-earth court. Broad gray-tiled gable roofs, restrained gently curved eaves, warm buff plaster, substantial dark timber, simple plank shutters and wood balcony. Clear entrance lower-left with simple low wood gateway; water jars and two covered travel bundles contained under porch, no animals or carts. Northern Yanjing/Datong Han timber construction in Khitan/Jurchen region, original unnamed game inn. Avoid luxurious palace composition. Show front ground edge4/3 of side. Ground edge angles26.565 degrees, slope0.5, flatter than classic isometric30degrees. Keep thin complete footprint perimeter.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景街景、厚地台、宫廷彩画、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件实际PNG：材质、细节密度、相机与拼接形态参考

created_time_basis: 生成源文件mtime，非服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize with integer rounding
processing.excluded_operations: no repaint, alpha thresholding, warping, flip, anisotropic correction or synthetic corners

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读取可见底面三点，±10源像素；非3D测绘。隐藏后角未实测；等比规格化不修正相机误差。

notes: 两层客房环院、左下入口、灰瓦木构；与宋客栈参考保持同级细节密度，局部沿用盆栽、素灯和石铺庭院，北方差异主要在温暖土灰墙材色，不宣称全面地域复原。 仅交单视图；历史游戏功能为原创扩展，屋架、窗棂等细部待考。
